old.H3-P2: Start doing some inner pl/ork. No, really! Get a copy of the free [reparenting guide](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/p/inner-child-self-love-tips-and-guided) and the [Hearthwork manual](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/p/hearthwork-an-integrated-peer-counseling), or go with another serious practice you already trust, and start practicing before you bring an audience into it.
old.H3-P3: Get two or three people together to form a practice group. Call it that, not a commune! Before you start talking about a shared future, meet regularly: practice listening and switching roles, get through at least one disagreement together, and keep your commitments to each other. One disagreement is enough, I promise!
old.H3-P4: Where would you find such people, you ask? Well, are there any unprogrammed Quaker meetings nearby? Any restorative-practice groups, or open-hearted congregations? Maybe a mature recovery group, or a meditation group? Or do you know anyone who came back from a long retreat kinder, rather than more impressed with themselves?

new.H3-P3: Get together with two or three people and call it a practice group, not a commune. Meet regularly. Work on listening, and on switching roles. Keep the commitments you make to each other. And get through at least one disagreement together. Just one? Yep, one is enough! Talk about a shared future after all that.

An open-hearted congregation could work too, or a mature recovery group, or a meditation group. Or look for someone who came back from a long retreat kinder, rather than more impressed with themselves!
